verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop processor, which is silicon hardware. A built-in, delegable AI assistant inside the product is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence mentions voice commands, Copilot+ integration and partner AI apps, but these are host-platform or third-party software features running on the chip, not an assistant the processor itself ships, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
